topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture context, outlines key themes in cancer evolution and microenvironments, and states the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages to drive clonal tumor evolution.

topics.label: Stem Cell Hierarchies and the Cell of Origin in Tumor Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how tissue differentiation hierarchies, stemness properties, and cellular plasticity determine tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion, Spatial Analysis, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments drive tumor progression, detail the molecular technologies used to map these cellular interactions, and synthesize the lecture's integrated evolutionary model.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
